null_field_handling.rule: Fields with null values in database/API are omitted entirely from UI; never replaced with fabricated placeholder text or fake defaults.

opening_hours.rule: Opening hours and 'Open Now' indicators are strictly omitted until verified opening hour data feeds are ingested.

rating_and_reviews.rule: Zero fabricated ratings. Ratings only rendered when genuine numeric score exists (> 0).

live_weather.rule: Weather requested only when genuine coordinates (lat/lon) exist. If weather fails or is unavailable, calm unavailable card renders without disrupting place detail view.

capability_gating.3d_models: GATED_OFF (Zero 3D tabs/affordances on mobile until verified GLB assets exist)
capability_gating.video_streams: GATED_OFF (Zero video player tabs until verified video feeds exist)
